title: How I AI: Meta Muse Wonder + How Brooke Lacey is scaling video with AI
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny's Podcast Network
summary: She explains why its active focus mode made it especially strong at billing support, inbox triage, computer use, and email writing, while its prototypes and visual work consistently fell short. She also shares how Muse compares with Opus 5.5, Astra, and Fable, and why she plans to test it in a few agent workflows without letting it anywhere near her front end.
takeaways: Biggest takeaways: Muse Wonder is the strongest agentic model Claire has tested at its price tier.
The model spent more time on complex agentic tasks than on quick requests, and the stronger results reflected that additional effort.
She plans to test it inside a few agent workflows because its multi-step reasoning and natural voice are strong.
